user.title: Connect to IoTrix Cloud
user.description: Enter the IoTrix API host and an account access token. Devices are discovered from the cloud response; no device IDs are hardcoded.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect IoTrix Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token was rejected. Enter a replacement access token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to IoTrix Cloud

abort.already_configured: This IoTrix account is already configured

init.title: IoTrix Cloud options
init.description: Select the dynamically discovered inverter and BMS used by D18 Guard. With exactly one compatible pair, automatic selection is safe.

data_description.device_refresh_interval: Seconds between owned-device list refreshes. Realtime measurements continue over WebSocket.
data_description.guard_hybrid_id: Only cloud devices whose driver exposes D18 are listed.
data_description.guard_bms_id: Guard uses this BMS current; inverter battery current is never used for trip decisions.
